text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah!
Big Sis Hishi Ama is fully back in action!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Since we had the chance,
I decided to run a Health Boost Week in the dorm!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text: We'll all eat some stamina-boosting food, take a good long bath, and sleep real well!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to that, I'm in top condition!
And on top of that, you know...

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Seeing them perk up like that
ended up giving me the biggest boost of all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Energized by her fellow dorm mates,
Hishi Amazon seems completely refreshed!
